verdict.rationale: Attio documents a public JSON REST API that apps use to read and write workspace data, with filtering and sorting, realtime webhooks, OAuth, SQL queries over workspace data, and an official MCP server, so core record and data operations are clearly programmable. Nothing claims the API matches the UI, and some actions are documented as UI-only: the Deal object can only be activated by an admin on the objects settings page. Many UI capabilities (workflow building, reporting dashboards, settings and permissions) show no API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage for workflows, reports, object/schema configuration and admin settings, a published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent corroboration.
